definitions.explanation: The last day of the typical work week. The kanji 金 means 'gold/metal' and relates to Venus (the 'metal planet' in East Asian tradition).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金曜日|きんようび}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{金曜日|きんようび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{金曜日|きんようび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会|あ}います→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: On Friday nights, I meet with friends.

examples.japanese: {金曜日|きんようび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{帰|かえ}りたい→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to go home early on Fridays.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金曜日|きんようび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きません→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you like to go see a movie next Friday?

notes:
{金曜日|きんようび} is Friday, the fifth day of the week.

ORIGIN:
{金|きん} (gold/metal) corresponds to the planet Venus in East Asian tradition. Each day of the week is associated with a celestial body.

ABBREVIATION:
{金曜|きんよう} or just {金|きん} in schedules.

CULTURE:
{金曜日|きんようび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (Friday night) is associated with after-work socializing in Japanese work culture. プレミアムフライデー was a campaign encouraging early departure on the last Friday of each month.

DAYS OF THE WEEK:
{日|にち}・{月|げつ}・{火|か}・{水|すい}・{木|もく}・{金|きん}・{土|ど}
(Sun・Mon・Tue・Wed・Thu・Fri・Sat)
